title: 真鍮の風鈴と、スパイスの香る雲の街
author: 灯守 ルカ

en.title: The Brass Wind Chime and the Spice‑Scented Cloud City
en.premise: I pilot a tiny steam‑powered airship, and one day a chance find of a "secret map" in an antique shop sends my journey in a new direction. The map points to an unknown floating island hidden beyond the clouds, where the air is perfumed with spices. Traveling from place to place, I soak up local customs and warm, comforting dishes while following the small promise left behind by the map’s creator.

zh.title: 真鍮的风铃与香料飘散的云之城
zh.premise: 我驾驶着靠蒸汽机驱动的小型飞艇旅行，某天在一家古董店里发现了一张“秘密地图”，从而迎来了新的篇章。地图指向云层之外隐藏的、弥漫着香料气息的未知漂浮岛屿。踏遍各地，感受当地风俗和温暖的料理，我追寻着地图持有者留下的那份小小约定。

prediction_results.question: 島で出会った謎の香りの正体と、二人の行く末は？
